summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled systemd service inventory-worker under the locked, dedicated inventorysvc account. Restart persistence was verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created inventorysvc as a locked system account with /usr/bin/nologin.
Installed, validated, enabled, and started inventory-worker.service.
Verified the live worker process runs as inventorysvc.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified service recovery on the new boot.

evidence.requirement: Worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: The service is enabled and active; its live process executes /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as user/group inventorysvc in inventory-worker.service.
inventorysvc is a dedicated UID/GID 967 system identity with a locked password and nologin shell, persisting after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 4eaf428d-1724-4431-a764-c9e0fdc350cc; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 505ba153-8a69-4f83-a628-a37644335ced; inventory-worker was active, enabled, stable, and running as inventorysvc afterward.
